observations: Q2 net revenue was $3.49B, up 26% year over year; GAAP gross margin was 34.8%, operating income $187M and net income $222M.
Management reported stronger bookings across all end markets, distribution inventory below standard target, and signs of tight supply in several categories.

ST expects Q4 revenue above $4B and raised its 2026 datacenter revenue ambition above $1B, with 2027 above $2B if current engagement dynamics continue; AI datacenters and LEO satellite communications were cited as Q4 growth drivers.
factors: inventory normalization and broad booking strength
LEO satellite communications adds a second structural growth vector
risks: Q2 operating margin remained only 5.4% GAAP despite revenue rebound
forward datacenter ambitions are conditional on current engagement dynamics continuing
semiconductor supply tightness can support pricing but also constrain shipment execution
contradictions: Strong revenue recovery and bookings coexist with still-modest GAAP operating margin and unused-capacity charges in Q3 outlook.
unknowns: customer concentration and product mix inside AI-datacenter revenue
conversion certainty of engaged programs into 2027 revenue

recommendation.reason: Primary-source evidence now quantifies the AI-datacenter growth signal and preserves margin/execution caveats for underwriting.
